# Three-defect closure research

All three defects are confirmed.

## Worktree-safe interception

The current workflow launcher starts Codex in the task working directory and supplies sandbox, approval, model, and optional provider configuration. It does not create or verify a governed Codex home, hook configuration, controller channel, receipt, or live hook challenge. Official Codex source defines structured PreToolUse input and a blocking/rewrite result, while project and user/system hooks come from distinct configuration sources. The documented worktree reproduction shows project-local hooks being ignored in a Git worktree while user hooks fire. The stable authority is therefore launcher-owned, per-session configuration plus preflight proof; project discovery cannot be the enforcement boundary. The local prevention host already parses Bash, apply_patch, and MCP calls and verifies a PID/session/config/hook-bound HMAC receipt, but no launcher wires it or establishes an authentication path without reading or copying credentials.

## Authoritative recurring eligibility

The registry is content-hashable but OwnerSpec contains no recurrence or availability policy. Action intent is persisted before dispatch without a registry revision or eligibility decision. Dispatch and the event ledger contain no immutable eligibility reason or registered-use denominator. Post-run observer eligibility is a different discovery concept. The stable denominator boundary is a controller-produced pre-dispatch eligibility event derived from a frozen registry revision, containing recurrence, availability, and explicit ineligible reason inputs. Later registry state or outcome must not reclassify it.

## Materialized owner contracts

The manifest contains 25 unique rows but every row stores identifier strings only. Current validation checks cardinality, source inventory hash, identifier syntax, and parent references; it does not resolve parameter schemas, canonical argv or typed calls, action class, full-unit budget, effect identity, reconciliation, terminal schema, recurrence eligibility, availability, or implementation source hashes. Materialized coverage for each of those fields is therefore 0/25. All 25 rows have sequence/source anchors. Twenty-one have at least one inspected local owner implementation; taggable-source-reload, taggable-api-deploy, taggable-admin-spa-deploy, and taggable-media-worker-deploy declare owner sources unavailable in the accessible roots. Those four must be explicit unavailable owners unless their source is separately supplied. Runtime behavior may not be inferred from prose or identifier names.

The 25 authoritative owner anchors are: local-workflow-orch-image→scripts/local_workflow_orch_image_harness.py; greenfield-full-drive→scripts/greenfield_full_drive.sh; remote-mcp-user-onboarding→dist/remote-mcp-user-admin/remote_mcp_user_admin_tui.py; taggable-source-reload→unavailable declared taggable-api reload-source.sh; mawf-playbook-full-test, mawf-playbook-speed-test, and mawf-playbook-blocker-reentry→scripts/mawf_playbook_test_sequence.py; github-app-repos-refresh→scripts/github_app_repos_refresh.py; claude-auth-token-refresh→scripts/claude_auth_refresh.sh and scripts/rotate-credentials.sh; taggable-api-deploy→unavailable declared taggable-api deploy-api.sh; taggable-admin-spa-deploy→unavailable declared taggable-admin-spa deploy-admin-spa.sh; taggable-media-worker-deploy→unavailable declared taggable-api deploy-media-worker.sh; airgapped-local-bulgarian-stt→callcenter-harness setup_airgapped_stt.sh; airgapped-redaction-stack→setup_airgapped_redaction.sh; callcenter-harness-provision-verify→the STT/redaction setup and cc smoke sources; airgapped-llm-judge→setup_airgapped_judge.sh and judge_ollama.py; secure-landing-seed→seed_landing.sh and scrub_and_retire.py; callcenter-harness-engine-invariants→test_engine_upgrades.py; discovery-promotion-lifecycle→scripts/discovery_promotion_lifecycle.py; commit-push-main→scripts/scoped_git_publish.py; discovery-bootstrap→scripts/discovery_bootstrap.py; discovery-candidate-reconciliation→scripts/discovery_candidate_reconciliation.py; convergence-checkpoint-run→scripts/convergence_checkpoint_run.py; scoped-context-edit→scripts/context_edit_guard.py; convergence-state-review-cycle→scripts/convergence_state_review_cycle.py.

## Acceptance boundary

Ordinary repositories and worktrees must both reject governed mutation if live host proof or authorized authentication is unavailable. Registered-use must reproduce only from immutable pre-dispatch eligibility and dispatch events tied to a registry content hash. Registry initialization must resolve each owner to a content-addressed executable contract or explicit unavailable state.

evidence_index.supported_claim: Defines the six frozen current/future requirements and acceptance boundaries for the three defects.
evidence_index.limitations: Specifies required behavior but does not prove current runtime behavior.

evidence_index.supported_claim: CodexCliWrapper launches Codex in task cwd and supplies sandbox, approval, model, and optional config without a governed home, hook preflight, or authentication boundary.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not prove Codex behavior after launch.

evidence_index.supported_claim: AgentExecutor chooses the task worktree as the Codex working directory.
evidence_index.limitations: Does not configure or verify hooks.
